mapper.select: select count(*) from url_mapping um where um.create_time <= #{time}
select count(*) from url_mapping um where um.create_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}
select count(*) from url_mapping um where um.expire_time >= #{time}
select um.id from url_mapping um where um.expire_time <= #{expireTime} and um.status = 1
SELECT t.d as name, COUNT( t.d ) as value FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( um.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) d FROM url_mapping um WHERE um.create_time >= #{beginTime} ) t GROUP BY t.d
select count(*) from url_mapping um where um.create_time >= #{beginTime}
select count(*) from url_mapping um where um.create_time >= #{beginTime} and um.expire_time <= #{expireTime}
